description: Domain registration record from the authoritative registry via RDAP (the successor to WHOIS): whether the domain is registered, registrar name and IANA ID, abuse contact, creation, last-change and expiration dates, days until expiry, EPP status codes, registry nameservers and DNSSEC delegation. Covers gTLDs and the ccTLDs that publish RDAP. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402).
